events.note: Added the runtime ops projection and its direct tests because current technical health and blocker aggregation must consume the background loop failure instead of leaving a false-green operator response.

expected: Every uncaught scheduler tick exception immediately produces a current BLOCKED technical health fact visible in status while the thread remains alive; repeated failures update bounded diagnostics, and a later successful tick automatically clears the active exception without erasing historical timestamps.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
